<P align=center style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>&#160;</B></P>
<P align=center style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>EXPLANATORY NOTE</B></P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>This Registration Statement on Form 10 (the &#8220;<B><I>Registration Statement</I></B>&#8221;) is being filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (the &#8220;<B><I>SEC</I></B>&#8221;) by Qualstar Corporation, a Nevada corporation (the &#8220;<B><I>Company</I></B>&#8221; or the &#8220;<B><I>Registrant</I></B>&#8221;), on a voluntary basis pursuant to Section 12(g) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the &#8220;<B><I>Exchange Act</I></B>&#8221;), in order to register the Company&#8217;s common stock under the Exchange Act. </P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Prior to April 2020, the Registrant had its common stock listed on The Nasdaq Stock Market and was a reporting company under the Exchange Act. In April 2020, the Company voluntarily delisted from Nasdaq and, based upon ownership of its shares by fewer than 300 holders of record, filed a Form 15 to deregister its common stock and suspend its public reporting obligations under the Exchange Act. The Company&#8217;s common stock has since been quoted on the OTC Markets Group under the trading symbol &#8220;QBAK.&#8221; The Company is now voluntarily filing this Registration Statement in order to re-register its common stock under Section 12(g) of the Exchange Act, resume its reporting obligations, enhance transparency for its stockholders, and facilitate improved liquidity for its common stock.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>This Registration Statement will become effective automatically 60 days after the date of the original filing pursuant to Section 12(g)(1) of the Exchange Act. Upon effectiveness of this Registration Statement, the Company will become subject to the reporting requirements of the Exchange Act, including the obligation to file annual reports on Form 10-K, quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, current reports on Form 8-K, proxy statements on Schedule 14A and such other reports and requirements applicable to issuers with securities registered pursuant to Section 12(g) of the Exchange Act.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>This Registration Statement, including the exhibits filed herewith, will be available for public inspection through the SEC&#8217;s Electronic Data Gathering, Analysis and Retrieval system (&#8220;EDGAR&#8221;) at www.sec.gov.</P>

<P align=center style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>AVAILABLE INFORMATION</B></P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Upon effectiveness of this Registration Statement, the Company will be subject to the informational requirements of the Exchange Act and, in accordance therewith, will file reports, proxy statements, and other information with the SEC. Such reports, proxy statements, and other information filed by the Company may be inspected and copied at the SEC&#8217;s public reference facilities and at the website maintained by the SEC at www.sec.gov. The Company will also make available on its website at <FONT style='color:#0000FF;border-bottom:1px solid #0000FF'>www.qualstar.com</FONT>, free of charge, its annual reports on Form 10-K, quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, current reports on Form 8-K, and amendments to those reports filed or furnished pursuant to Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Exchange Act as soon as reasonably practicable after such material is electronically filed with or furnished to the SEC. Information contained on, or accessible through, the Company&#8217;s website is not a part of, and is not incorporated by reference into, this Registration Statement.</P>

<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#909090;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><A name=item1 /><B>ITEM 1. BUSINESS</B></P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>COMPANY OVERVIEW</B></P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Qualstar Corporation (collectively with its subsidiaries, &#8220;<B><I>Qualstar</I></B>&#8221;, the &#8220;<B><I>Company</I></B>&#8221;, &#8220;<B><I>we</I></B>&#8221;, &#8220;<B><I>us</I></B>&#8221; or &#8220;<B><I>our</I></B>&#8221;) is a custom designer and one-stop provider of enterprise archival data storage hardware and software solutions and compact, high-efficiency power supply solutions. </P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:36pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD>Our data storage systems are marketed under the Qualstar brand and include highly scalable automated magnetic tape libraries and software used to store, retrieve, and manage data across mission-critical markets including media and entertainment, banking, government, military, oil and gas, data centers, high-performance computing, medical, and education. Our data storage solutions include models ranging from entry-level to enterprise and are a cost-effective resource for organizations requiring backup, recovery, and archival storage of critical electronic information. Our distribution channels include resellers, system integrators, and original equipment manufacturers (&#8220;<B><I>OEM</I></B>s&#8221;). &nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:36pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD>In addition, the Company is a leading provider of standard, modified-standard, and custom-designed power supply solutions marketed under the N2Power brand. Our power supply solutions give OEMs and product designers more functionality while reducing thermal loads, cooling requirements, and operating costs. We currently sell our power supply solutions to OEMs across a wide range of markets, including telecom/networking equipment, audio/visual, industrial, gaming, and medical.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><BR>Qualstar Corporation was incorporated in California in 1984 and re-incorporated in Nevada in 2026. It has three wholly owned subsidiaries: the N2Power, Inc. subsidiary (&#8220;<B><I>N2Power</I></B>&#8221;), a Nevada corporation, operates the Company&#8217;s power supplies business; the Q-Smart Data Limited (China) subsidiary pursues new data storage business opportunities in Asia; and the Qualstar Limited (U.K.) subsidiary supports expansion of the Company&#8217;s data storage business in the United Kingdom, Europe and Africa. </P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><BR>We sell our products globally through authorized resellers and distributors and directly to OEMs. Our data storage products are manufactured by our OEM suppliers in other parts of the world and configured to order by us at our facility in Camarillo, California, or at our facility in Shenzhen, China, or by our fulfillment and logistics partner in Warsaw, Poland. N2Power uses contract manufacturers in Asia to produce our power supply solutions. </P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>DATA STORAGE PRODUCTS</B></P>
<P align=center style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>Background</B>&#160;&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Industry research has projected that installed storage capacity across enterprise data centers will increase from approximately 8.4 zettabytes in 2025 to approximately 26.3 zettabytes by 2030, with the volume of data being generated growing significantly faster than the capacity to store such data economically on spinning disk, and it is estimated that at least 80% of installed capacity in 2025 is classified as archival or &#8220;cold&#8221; data that is infrequently accessed and can tolerate higher access latency. For this type of data, Linear Tape-Open (&#8220;LTO&#8221;) technology continues to be the predominant medium for long-term data retention and archiving. According to the LTO Program, 160.3 exabytes of LTO tape capacity were shipped in 2025, the second-highest annual volume on record, and LTO tape capacity shipments increased 57% year-over-year in the first quarter of 2026. LTO data storage solutions can store terabytes of data, maintain data integrity for up to 30 years, feature barcode tracking systems to keep data organized, and include removable media that protects against cyber-attacks and ransomware from air gap. LTO systems are the most cost-effective long-term storage solutions: they have a total cost of ownership that is four to eight times lower than disk storage and offer a substantially lower lifecycle carbon footprint with lower power consumption. </P>
<HR style='border:0;height:0;width:0;margin:14pt 0 0 0'><P align=center style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>5</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#909090;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>This growth in data storage requirements is driven by the proliferation of digital data, including the rapidly increasing volume of unstructured data generated by artificial intelligence, high-performance computing (&#8220;HPC&#8221;), e-commerce, digital media streaming, video and imagery, scientific data sets and other sensor-derived data. This presents both opportunities and challenges for organizations seeking to use their data for artificial intelligence and other applications: vast amounts of potentially valuable information are contained in video, imagery, security camera footage, scientific data sets and other sensor-generated data, and to preserve the ability to analyze and derive value from this information over time, organizations must capture, protect and retain it for many years or even decades. These trends are increasing demand for cost-effective, scalable archiving, preservation, accessibility and security solutions. As organizations and regulators require longer retention, cyber-resilient recovery, ransomware protection, and reliable access to archived data, HPC cold-tier architectures and air-gapped tape solutions are becoming increasingly important. We believe these trends will continue to drive demand for standards-based, tape-based data storage products.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>The widely used &#8220;3:2:1 principle&#8221; also supports demand for LTO storage. Under this principle, organizations maintain three copies of important data on two different types of storage media (which can include local servers, cloud, disk and tape), with one copy maintained off-site. Since tape is removable, as one of these storage media, it provides an offline copy physically isolated from the primary network.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Despite its advantages, tape nevertheless competes with other data storage technologies, including hard disk drives, solid-state and flash storage and cloud-based storage solutions. Advances in these technologies, including reductions in cost and improvements in capacity, performance and energy efficiency, could reduce the relative advantages of tape storage over time.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>Strategy</B></P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Our strategy is to leverage our 40 years of experience in the data storage industry, our strong financial position and our leadership team&#8217;s proven M&amp;A execution skills to scale our one-stop hardware/software solutions platform through broader product offerings, partnerships, new software, and acquisitions. We aim to become a global leader in the data storage industry by providing the lowest total cost of ownership, ransomware protection, and fast/global fulfillment with US-based support. Qualstar is prepared to meet the increasing demands of data storage and archiving through cyber-resilient, sustainable archive automation for the modern cold tier. As an independent tape library provider offering solutions that combine our hardware with the software that best meets the customer&#8217;s requirements rather than a &#8220;one size fits all&#8221; approach, we seek to provide standards-based LTO solutions without vendor lock-in or slot licensing fees. </P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>To achieve these objectives, we plan to pursue the following:</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:43.2pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD><B>Cyber-resilient, sustainable archive automation.</B> We will develop and promote solutions that support offline recovery, energy-aware archives, and modular scaling from terabytes to exabytes.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:43.2pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD><B>Standards-based LTO tape libraries for</B> <B>the</B> <B>modern cold tier</B>. Our product portfolio supports long-term retention, portability, and integration with modern archive workflows.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:43.2pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD><B>Focus on strategic partnerships and opportunistic M&amp;A to build</B> a <B>global data storage solution platform</B>. We will leverage our management team&#8217;s extensive M&amp;A and dealmaking expertise to pursue strategic relationships and select M&amp;A and investment opportunities in order to expand our hardware and software solutions and service capabilities and extend our market reach.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:43.2pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD><B>Lowest TCO, ransomware protection through air-gapped tape.</B> We will emphasize tape&#8217;s low power-at-rest profile, long media life, and physical separation from network threats.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:43.2pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD><B>US-based support with global reach</B>. We will continue to support customers through our U.S.-based team and international partners, distributors, and service resources.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:43.2pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD><B>Software-agnostic platform and no slot licensing fees.</B> We will continue to provide customers with full use of their library capacity and flexibility across archive software stacks.&nbsp;</P>
<HR style='border:0;height:0;width:0;margin:14pt 0 0 0'><P align=center style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>6</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#909090;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:43.2pt'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>Our Storage Solutions&#160;&#160;</B>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Qualstar offers LTO-based data storage devices for various vertically focused businesses and institutions such as media and entertainment, banking, government, military, oil and gas, data centers, high-performance computing, research, medical, education, telecom, and life sciences. Our products meet the data storage requirements for highly regulated industries such as medicine, law, and finance.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>We deliver cost-effective data protection and archival storage ranging from rack mounts to stand-alone tape libraries, meeting data storage needs for both standard and more complex small and mid-sized enterprise environments with stringent performance and data availability requirements. Our products ship within three business days from the U.S., Europe, and Asia, come pre-configured and tested, are easy to install and maintain, and have a standard three-year warranty. We offer U.S.-based customer services and no slot licensing fees and are able to scale with the demands of growing businesses.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Our Q Series provides capacities ranging from approximately 360 Terabytes to over 11.52 Petabytes. The Q8 is an entry-level tape library with up to 8 slots and up to 360 Terabytes of capacity; the Q24 is a compact mid-range tape library with up to 24 slots and up to 1,080 Terabytes of capacity; the Q40 is a mid-enterprise tape library expandable up to 640 slots and up to 11.52 Petabytes of capacity; and the Q80 is an enterprise tape library expandable up to 560 slots and up to 10.08 Petabytes of capacity.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>For the larger enterprise market, we also offer the Q1000+ Powered by Orion, an enterprise-class rack-scale library offering standards-based LTO, no vendor lock-in, and rack-scale archive automation. It provides 44.6 PB native per 48U rack and supports multi-rack scaling and supports LTFS, WORM-capable workflows and encryption-ready operations. Remote management enables shared operations across sites.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>POWER SUPPLY INDUSTRY</B></P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>Background</B></P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>The power supply industry comprises a few large suppliers and a large number of smaller companies that focus on specialized products and markets. Currently, the power solutions market for our N2Power brand products includes the servers, storage and network (&#8220;SSN&#8221;), industrial and transportation (&#8220;IND&#8221;), network power systems (&#8220;NPS&#8221;), medical, gaming and lighting markets.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>We believe the following key trends will continue to drive demand for our power solutions products:</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:36pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD><B>Increasing power demand in the communications infrastructure industry.</B> The proliferation of the internet, wireless communications, broadband applications, server and storage farms, data centers and their related infrastructures, and other new technologies has exponentially increased the amount of information transmitted worldwide. As a result, the push for higher bandwidth and more efficient and effective power solutions has driven a faster replacement cycle for telecommunications equipment, as well as strong infrastructure expansion.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:36pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD><B>Increasing demand for high conversion efficiencies, high power density, and digital power management.</B> Efforts to reduce energy consumption in the EU, the United States, and Asia are increasing the demand for high conversion efficiencies and digital power control. In addition, groups such as the Climate Savers Computing Initiative, a consortium of companies including Google, Intel, and other eco-conscious businesses and conservation organizations, are promoting the development, deployment, and adoption of smart technologies that can improve a computer&#8217;s power efficiency and reduce its energy consumption when inactive. Because a large portion of electrical energy waste occurs during power conversion, power companies can reduce end-user operating costs by improving conversion efficiency. Our AC/DC power supplies provide conversion efficiency ratings up to 94%. Higher conversion efficiencies reduce overall power usage, cutting greenhouse gas emissions and total infrastructure ownership costs.&nbsp;</P>
<HR style='border:0;height:0;width:0;margin:14pt 0 0 0'><P align=center style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>7</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#909090;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>Strategy</B></P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Our primary objective for our power supply business is to remain a recognized and well-regarded provider of high-efficiency, high-density power solutions for the data center equipment, medical, gaming, test equipment, transportation, industrial, and telecommunications network power markets while continuing to seek expansion opportunities. To achieve this objective, we plan to:</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:43.2pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD><B>Continue to expand our sales channels and geographies. </B>We aim to promote the N2Power brand globally and target larger OEMs and distributors with a presence in markets and geographies we do not currently serve.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:43.2pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD><B>Continue to increase volume with our current OEM customers.</B> Our OEM customers are constantly changing their products and introducing new products. We are striving to become the supplier of choice within our OEM customer base, leveraging our existing relationships to drive volume growth within the same sales channel.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:43.2pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD><B>Continue to expand our footprint in the current markets we serve.</B> We are currently supporting the data center equipment, medical, gaming, test equipment, transportation, industrial, and telecommunications systems markets. We have secured several sizable OEM customers and are aiming to add new OEM customers in these markets.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:43.2pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD><B>Expand our product line while continuing to pursue higher power levels and greater conversion efficiency in a smaller footprint.</B> Minimizing space requirements within our customers&#8217; products is critical, and as a result, there is a continuing need for smaller packaging while delivering additional power. Our product roadmap addresses these needs, and our objective is to lead the industry with the greatest efficiency in the smallest footprint and the highest power available, delivering advantages to our OEM customers as they leverage our technology in their product designs.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:43.2pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD><B>Expand our product line through private label offerings, strategic partnerships and opportunistic M&amp;A.</B> Where we lack products in certain markets or at specific power levels, we intend to expand our product line by using our relationships with other power solutions manufacturers to incorporate their core products in private label offerings to complement our own. In addition, we will leverage our management team&#8217;s extensive M&amp;A and dealmaking expertise to pursue strategic relationships and select M&amp;A and investment opportunities.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:43.2pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD><B>Organize our technology resources for fast time-to-market on derivative products.</B> Our customers continually request derivative configurations of our existing products. To serve these needs effectively, we are organizing our engineering resources for fast turnaround on these designs to shorten our OEM customers&#8217; design cycle and speed time-to-market.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>Our Power Solution Products</B></P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>N2 Power designs and manufactures energy-dense, open-frame and enclosed switch-mode power supplies for OEM markets worldwide. These power solution products convert, regulate, purify, manage, or distribute electrical power for electronic equipment. Our products are used in a variety of applications and convert AC current from the power grid to DC current, or modify the voltage being delivered (DC to DC). We target markets where high efficiency and power density are important.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>We sell standard, modified-standard, and custom-designed products: standard products are sold unmodified to our customers; modified-standard products are based on lightly modified versions of standard products; and custom products are designed specifically to the customer&#8217;s specification and are not generally sold to other customers. Custom products may require non-recurring engineering and certification costs (typically reimbursed by the customer) to bring the product to production. With our core competencies in both power and mechanical design, we are an Optimized Power Systems Manufacturer (OPSM), offering complete custom power assemblies that eliminate the need for our customers to purchase additional components to integrate our power supplies into their products.</P>
<HR style='border:0;height:0;width:0;margin:14pt 0 0 0'><P align=center style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>8</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#909090;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>

<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>CUSTOMERS</B></P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Our solution-focused data storage offerings are designed for OEMs, information technology departments, and the enterprise market and also address cyber vault and ransomware protection, cold tier, media preservation, and regulatory retention use cases. We sell our storage products through our worldwide authorized distributor and reseller network. Our power supply products are sold through distributors and directly through independent outside sales representatives. All our products and services are designed and manufactured to address our customers&#8217; stringent requirements and reliability standards. The following provides additional detail on our channels:</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:43.2pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD><B>Storage reseller channel.</B> Our reseller channel includes systems integrators, value-added resellers (&#8220;VARs&#8221;) and value-added distributors (&#8220;VADs&#8221;). Our resellers frequently package our products as part of a comprehensive data processing system or with other storage devices as a complete storage subsystem, frequently recommending our products as replacement solutions when customers upgrade their systems or bundling our products with storage management software specific to the end user's system. We support the reseller channel through our dedicated field sales representatives and technical support technicians.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:43.2pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD><B>Storage OEM channel.</B> OEM customers incorporate our storage products with their application software and other components to deliver a focused solution. Our products may or may not carry our label.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:43.2pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD><B>N2Power OEM channel.</B> We have supply agreements with the major power supply customers who incorporate our products into their server, gaming, network, and industrial product offerings.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:7.2pt'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>&#160;We divide our worldwide sales into three geographical regions:</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:43.2pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD>The Americas: United States, Mexico, Canada, and South America;&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:43.2pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD>EMEA: Europe, the Middle East and Africa;&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:43.2pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD>APAC: Asia and Pacific countries.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:7.2pt'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>We support our customers in the Americas primarily through a network of trained distribution partners and representatives located throughout the region. We support our foreign customers through our distributors and resellers located throughout these regions.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Sales to customers outside of the United States represent a significant portion of our sales. International sales are subject to various risks and uncertainties (see &quot;Risk Factors&quot; in Part I, Item 1A of this report.) We also offer lead-generation opportunities to key channel partners. Our sales management and engineering personnel provide support to the channel partners and visit potential customer sites to demonstrate the technical advantages of our products. We maintain press relations in the United States and participate in trade shows worldwide.</P>

<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>CUSTOMER SERVICE AND SUPPORT</B></P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>Customer service and support are key elements of our company strategy and critical components of our commitment to making enterprise-class support and services available to companies of all sizes. Our technical support staff is trained to assist our customers with deployment and compatibility for any combination of hardware platforms, operating systems and backup, data protection, and storage management software. Our application engineers assist with complex customer issues. We maintain global toll-free service and support phone lines and provide self-service and support through our website and email.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'>Standard warranties include:</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:36pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD>Three-year standard limited warranty on our &#8220;Q-Series&#8221; products;&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt;margin-left:36pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD>Optional 24/7 or next business day onsite service on our data storage products in many countries throughout the world; and&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:36pt'><KBD style='position:absolute;font:10pt Symbol;margin-left:-18pt'><FONT style=font-family:Symbol>&#183;</FONT></KBD>Three-year return to factory warranty on our N2Power products.&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0;margin-left:7.2pt'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:6pt'><B>ENGINEERING</B>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Our power supply engineering teams in the U.S. and Singapore work to improve our current products and create new products. Our engineers work closely with our customers to incorporate modifications for their specific project requirements. Our data storage business utilizes consultants for any engineering requirements.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>We have also formed strategic partnerships for supplementary engineering resources with third-party companies to capture additional state-of-the-art technology-driven power designs. These partnerships allow us to increase our product breadth by releasing more standard and modified standard power solution products.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>MANUFACTURING AND SUPPLIERS</B></P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>We perform product assembly, integration, and testing for our storage products at our facility in Camarillo, California. Our private label storage products are manufactured in various geographical locations by a select group of suppliers. Our N2Power-branded products are manufactured in China by specifically qualified contract manufacturers. We purchase tape drives, chassis, printed circuit boards, integrated circuits, and all other major components from outside suppliers. We carefully select suppliers based on their ability to provide quality parts and components that meet technical specifications and volume requirements. We actively monitor these suppliers, but we are subject to substantial risks associated with the performance of our suppliers. For certain components, we qualify a single source, which magnifies the risk of shortages and decreases our ability to negotiate with that supplier. </P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>COMPETITION</B>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>The worldwide data storage market is highly competitive. Competitors vary in size from small start-ups to large multinational corporations that may have substantially greater financial, engineering and marketing resources than us. In the tape automation market, we believe our primary competitors are IBM, Dell Inc., Hewlett Packard, Spectra Logic and Quantum Corporation. As a software-neutral tape solutions provider, Qualstar competes by offering standards-based LTO solutions without vendor lock-in or slot licensing fees. Key competitive factors include product features, reliability, durability, scalability, interoperability, service and support, and price. Barriers to entry in tape automation are relatively high as this is an established industry that is capital intensive.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>In addition to competition from other tape library manufacturers, we face competition from other technologies such as disk-based storage, solid-state and flash storage, and cloud storage solutions. Advances in these technologies, including reductions in cost and improvements in capacity and performance, could reduce the relative advantages of tape-based storage over time.</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&nbsp;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>Our primary power supply competitors are Meanwell, Artesyn, TDK Lambda, XP Power and Bel Power. Key competitive factors in these markets include price, performance, functionality, availability, interoperability, connectivity, time to market, enhancements and total value of ownership. Barriers to entry for power supply products are high as the industry is capital intensive. </P>
<HR style='border:0;height:0;width:0;margin:14pt 0 0 0'><P align=center style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>10</P>
<HR style='page-break-after:always;border:0;height:3pt;background-color:#909090;margin:8pt 0'><P style=line-height:0;margin:0></P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>The markets for all of our products are characterized by significant price competition and we anticipate that our products will continue to face substantial pricing pressure.<B>&#160;</B></P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'><B>INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY</B>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>We rely on a combination of trademark, trade secret and other intellectual property laws to protect our proprietary rights. Despite our efforts to protect our proprietary rights, competition in our businesses is significant. We believe that, because of the rapid pace of technological change in the tape storage and power supply industries, patent, copyright, trademark and trade secret protection are less significant than factors such as market responsiveness, knowledge, ability, the experience of our personnel, and timely new product introductions. </P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>&#160;</P>
<P align=justify style='font:10pt Times New Roman;margin:0'>We enter into Employee Proprietary Information and Inventions Agreements with all employees to protect our technology and designs.</P>

These include, but are not limited to, regulations relating to product safety and certification, environmental compliance, import and export controls, data privacy, labor and employment, and workplace health and safety. Our power supply products are subject to various domestic and international regulatory standards and certifications, including safety certifications from Underwriters Laboratories (UL), the Canadian Standards Association (CSA), and compliance with European Union directives such as the CE marking requirements and the Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) directive. Our products sold internationally are subject to the export control laws and regulations of the United States, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) administered by the Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) of the U.S. Department of Commerce. Changes in tariff policies, trade restrictions, or export controls could affect our supply chain and the cost or availability of our products. The stock split increased the number of issued and outstanding shares of common stock from 1,380,853 to 4,142,559 at that time. Except as otherwise noted, all references to common stock, common stock issuable upon exercise of stock options and corresponding per share information throughout this Registration Statement have been retroactively adjusted to reflect the stock split. </P>
